subject: Creativity
title: Laughter Yoga: The Body Doesn't Know the Difference
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Laughter Yoga: The Body Doesn't Know the Difference.

hook.text: Dr. Madan Kataria gathered strangers in a Mumbai park in 1995 and asked them to laugh for no reason.

buildup.text: Laughter yoga combines forced laughter with yogic breathing.

discovery.text: Your body can't tell real from forced laughter — both cut cortisol, boost endorphins, and strengthen immunity.

twist.text: No jokes required. No humor needed. The physical act of laughing itself triggers all the health benefits — the brain.

climax.text: Now 16,000+ laughter yoga clubs span 110 countries. Hospitals use it for pain relief, and companies for stress.

punchline.text: You don't need a reason to laugh. Your body doesn't care why — it heals anyway.

quiz.question: What key discovery underlies laughter yoga?
options: Jokes are necessary for health benefits
The body can't distinguish real from forced laughter
